item.brief: Implement ledger.py according to SPEC.md. Preserve the documented API and handle every specified error and boundary case. Commit the completed changes on the task branch; do not push. Acceptance: implementation matches SPEC.md, focused tests cover specified errors and boundaries, tests pass, and the work is committed.

evidence.before: Ran 2 tests; both errored with NotImplementedError.
evidence.caption: Baseline test run before implementation failed because Ledger raised NotImplementedError; final suite passes all eight tests.

pr.body: Implemented the documented API in ledger.py using a per-ledger lock to serialize transfer checks and writes with snapshots. Added focused standard-library tests for constructor and amount validation, validation order, unknown accounts, ceiling and same-account behavior, copy isolation, and opposite-direction concurrent transfers. Checks: python -m unittest -v (8 passed), python -m py_compile ledger.py test_ledger.py (passed), git diff --check (passed). Assumption: dict subclasses and str subclasses are accepted where the spec says dict/string; balances and amounts require exact built-in int as specified. No known limitations.
pr.summary: Implemented bounded atomic ledger transfers with thread-safe snapshots. Before: Ledger methods were unimplemented and the two basic tests errored. Now: validation, failure atomicity, ceiling rules, snapshot isolation, and concurrent opposite transfers are covered.
pr.title: Implement atomic ledger transfers

risk.why: Small contained in-memory behavior change in ledger.py with focused tests in test_ledger.py; no persistence, API break, or cross-cutting changes. Per-ledger locking is straightforward and the independent reviewer confirmed it does not raise risk to high. All listed checks passed.
